verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official remote MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) explicitly built for natural-language access to a user's Gusto account data via Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor, plus a public agent-friendly CLI with bundled skills for Claude/Cursor/Windsurf that lets agents (driven by natural language) run payroll-prep workflows with human-in-the-loop confirmation. This directly satisfies the story of operating Gusto via natural-language commands rather than only via developer API integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming real-world natural-language MCP/CLI usage (evidence is entirely first-party docs and GitHub artifacts, no community corroboration).
